cd /var/openhands/conversations/7a0f58a298fa4500b9e92a3caa285d94/events && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, glob, re
files = sorted(glob.glob('event-*.json'))
pats = {
 'resifactory': r'rf_live_[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+|ResiFactory_[a-z0-9]+|resifactory\.net|premium\.resifactory\.net',
 'proxidize': r'pg\.proxi\.es|jPDZYa2fSH3jMmQN|proxidize',
 'flashproxy': r'fpk_live_[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+|flashproxy\.io|6pyu2taqjl',
 'ipcove': r'ipcc[a-z0-9]+|ipck_[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+|gateway\.ipcove\.com',
 'captchaai': r'ixvwhhocndcyyon2f1vbixds6ltuujnb|captchaai\.com|ocr\.captchaai\.com',
 'ddosguard': r'JB1BY4C17D99TN[A-Za-z0-9\-]*|ddos-guard',
 'gmail': r'ftnhrjnivohmtvju|mszz vqfk nzjq feqw|woybangsatkauuu',
 'allmodels': r'sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]+',
 'hex': r'hex_[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}',
 'obscurify': r'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}',
 'nomask': r'nmk_live_[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}',
 'cloudeflare_domain': r'sinaja\.cyou',
}
found={k:set() for k in pats}
for f in files:
    j=json.load(open(f))
    if j.get('kind')!='MessageEvent': continue
    if j.get('llm_message',{}).get('role')!='user': continue
    c=j['llm_message'].get('content')
    t=c[0].get('text') if isinstance(c,list) and c and isinstance(c[0],dict) else str(c)
    for k,p in pats.items():
        for m in re.findall(p,t): found[k].add(m)
for k,v in found.items():
    print(f"--- {k} ({len(v)})")
    for x in sorted(v)[:8]: print("   ",x)
EOF
